body: Are you missing the micrometer-registry-prometheus extension?

I know about that, see vvv from description.

> quarkus-micrometer-registry-prometheus is needed to compile succesfully into native when using combination of infinispan-client + micrometer. But when using just infinispan-client or just micrometer no additional deps are needed.
So the main question is: Is there anything to improve the user experience?
This should not happen - it's bad user experience. We might need some kind of substitution to make it work properly.

issue.title: Properly include Prometheus related code
issue.body:
The way the test was being done previously
was checking the build time classpath instead
of the runtime class for the presence of the
Prometheus Registry.
